item.title: Build a game by directing AI
item.dc:creator: Mark Calleja
item.description: A build sequence for ages 13 to 17: make a browser game by directing an AI, and keep the thinking for yourself. Five steps, each with a check.

item.title: Collaborating with LLMs: Level Up from Centaur to Cyborg
item.dc:creator: Mark Calleja
item.description: How centaur and cyborg ways of working can turn large language models into useful collaborators, with practical prompts for deeper thinking.

item.title: Scar Tissue: The Editorial Residue LLMs Leave Behind
item.dc:creator: Mark Calleja
item.description: Why finished AI-assisted projects keep answering questions their readers never asked, and how to remove that editorial residue without losing useful rationale.
